external_id.description: e.g. Wazuh agent id '003' (unique per manager+org)
external_id.title: External Id

check_id.description: Scanner check id, e.g. Greenbone NVT OID
check_id.title: Check Id

RiskScore.description: Contextual 0-100 (legacy lib/riskScore.ts inputs). The formula version is part of the result.
RiskScore.title: RiskScore

ScaPolicyResult.description: One SCA policy evaluation for one endpoint (Wazuh /sca/{agent_id} + /sca/{agent_id}/checks/{policy}).
ScaPolicyResult.title: ScaPolicyResult

ScanClaimResult.description:
Answer to a worker's claim. `job` is present only when a job is handed out. In this release scanning is
disabled by design, so the API answers `scanning_disabled` and never hands out a job.
ScanClaimResult.title: ScanClaimResult

ScanJobClaim.description: Sent to the VMS worker on claim (atomic, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED). Greenbone config names are worker-side.
ScanJobClaim.title: ScanJobClaim

ScanJobRequest.description: Human API (vms:scan). Refused unless every target is inside an active ScopeApproval allowing the activity.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key; a repeat with the same key returns the first result
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

ScanJobRequest.title: ScanJobRequest

ScanResultBatch.description: Worker -> API. No org field: the job (and so the organisation) comes from job_id + worker identity.

batch_id.description: Client-chosen key; a repeat with the same key returns the first result
batch_id.title: Batch Id

ScanResultBatch.title: ScanResultBatch

ScopeApproval.description: An organisation-approved scope (P27 model). OpenVAS is allowed only when listed here; never by env var.
ScopeApproval.title: ScopeApproval

site_id.description: Required for private addresses and ranges
site_id.title: Site Id

SiteScopedAddress.description: An IP address is only meaningful inside a site: 10.0.0.5 at site A is not 10.0.0.5 at site B.
SiteScopedAddress.title: SiteScopedAddress

VerificationRecord.description: Verification history entry: only a completed, in-scope scan job may verify or reopen a finding.
VerificationRecord.title: VerificationRecord

asset_id.description: Consolidation: the canonical asset of the host
asset_id.title: Asset Id

kev.description: Consolidation: a CVE of the finding is in the organization's KEV intelligence
kev.title: Kev

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key; a repeat with the same key returns the first result
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

VmsScopeCreate.description: Human API (vms:scope). An approved scope is the only thing a scan may touch.
VmsScopeCreate.title: VmsScopeCreate

VmsStatus.description: VMS readiness for the active organization: whether scanning may run and which V2 workers have reported.
VmsStatus.title: VmsStatus

WazuhEndpoint.description: Read model of a Wazuh agent mapped to an asset. Ownership comes from the group/source map, never the agent.
WazuhEndpoint.title: WazuhEndpoint
